function f(this: { x: number }) {
  return this.x;
}
type H = { x: number; f: typeof f };

function viaIndex(o: { a: H } | undefined) {
  console.log(o?.a['f']());
}
function viaProperty(o: { b: { a: H } } | undefined) {
  console.log(o?.b.a.f(), o?.['b']['a'].f());
}
function viaCall(o: { g(): H } | undefined) {
  console.log(o?.g().f(), o?.g()['f']());
}
function viaElement(o: H[] | undefined) {
  console.log(o?.[0].f());
}
function viaOptionalLinks(o: { a: H | undefined } | undefined) {
  console.log(o?.a?.f(), o?.a?.['f']());
}

viaIndex({ a: { x: 1, f } });
viaIndex(undefined);
viaProperty({ b: { a: { x: 2, f } } });
viaCall({ g: () => ({ x: 3, f }) });
viaElement([{ x: 4, f }]);
viaOptionalLinks({ a: { x: 5, f } });
viaOptionalLinks({ a: undefined });

type Counter = { value: number; read(this: Counter): number; wrap(this: Counter): { nested: number } };
const counter: Counter = {
  value: 6,
  read() {
    return this.value;
  },
  wrap() {
    return { nested: this.value };
  },
};
function assertedCalls(candidate?: Counter): number[] {
  return [(candidate?.read!)(), (candidate?.['read']!)()];
}
function assertedValue(candidate?: Counter): number {
  return candidate?.value!;
}
function continuedAssertion(candidate?: Counter) {
  return [candidate?.read!(), candidate?.wrap!().nested];
}
console.log(assertedCalls(counter), assertedValue(counter));
console.log(continuedAssertion(counter), continuedAssertion());
